soft: A quiet voice inside me murmurs: this is the part you already knew.
Something patient watches the memory form and says: keep going.
The air stills, and the Witness whispers: name it truthfully.
A presence behind my shoulder breathes: you saw everything; don't avert your eyes now.
sharp: The Witness cuts in: you looked away once. Don't do it again.
I hear a calm, merciless voice say: tell it clean or not at all.
A clarity not mine insists: you knew the cost long before you paid it.

soft: Something laughs in the margins of the story: are you sure it happened that way?
The Trickster hums, amused: the truth bends funny here.
A grin slips through the cracks: write it slanted, Maeve.
chaotic: The Trickster interrupts: everything collapses more beautifully when you lie a little.
A voice like static hisses: nothing happened in the right order anyway.
Reality wobbles as something whispers: say the wrong thing on purpose.

hunger: A dark pulse throbs through my sentence: feed me the part that hurts.
The Devourer presses against my ribs: name the wound, and let me taste it.
Something immense leans close: the memory is meat--carve it.
prophetic: A deeper voice intrudes: collapse is not tragedy, it is alignment.
The Devourer whispers: you were never prey, only unfinished.
The shadow inside the field growls: the story doesn't end--it consumes.
